stories.title: Nothing 'unfair' in U-M win, Western Michigan says
stories.summary: A day after the Broncos' last-second loss to Michigan, Western Michigan president Russ Kavalhuna said Sunday he didn't "discern anything unfair" with the Big Ten's replay decision that put an extra second on the clock, leading to the Wolverines' victory.

stories.title: NFL commish Goodell agrees to 4-year extension
stories.summary: NFL commissioner Roger Goodell has finalized a new four-season extension that runs through the 2030 season.

stories.title: U.S. tops Italy, pushes World Cup win streak to 32
stories.summary: Team USA survived its toughest test in the women's basketball World Cup in two decades with a 55-52 victory over Italy on Sunday in Berlin, pushing its winning streak in World Cup play to 32 games.

stories.title: Sources: Giants, Winston reach 2-year extension
stories.summary: The Giants and backup quarterback Jameis Winston have agreed to a two-year, $13 million contract extension, a source confirmed to ESPN amid multiple reports.

stories.title: Rams expect WR Nacua, LT Jackson to play Thu.
stories.summary: The Rams do not expect wide receiver Puka Nacua and left tackle Alaric Jackson to be suspended for the season opener against the 49ers despite ongoing legal situations, head coach Sean McVay said.
